title: Nectarous Mexican Oysters Tamales
description: Rich, glassy-jelly tamales bursting with fresh oysters, coconut, and a toasted almond finish. A flambé of pineapple juice adds a dramatic finish.
instructions: Soak corn husks in warm water for 30 minutes to soften.
Whisk coconut milk with lime juice, pineapple juice, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, sea salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Rinse oysters, shuck, and pat dry, then fold each into the coconut mixture.
Spread the oyster mixture onto each husk, leaving a 2-inch border, then close the husk and tie with kitchen twine.
Steam tamales over medium heat for 30 minutes, turning every 10 minutes.
While tamales steam, heat 1 teaspoon of vegetable oil in a small pan until hot, then pour in 100ml pineapple juice and ignite to flambé.
Carefully pour the flaming juice over the cooked tamales, letting it splash and caramelize.
Sprinkle roasted almond flakes and lime zest over the tamales before serving.
